blocks.text: Create a practice Laravel project with Composer, then replace routes/web.php with one example. Start php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000. These read-only starter routes need no database.
Send a client to another page

blocks.title: Send a client to another page
blocks.code:
<?php
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
Route::get("/start", fn () => redirect("/hello"));
Route::get("/hello", fn () => "Welcome");

blocks.text: The redirect contains /hello as its location. A browser follows it and reads Welcome.
Inspect the first response Location header.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A redirect tells the client to make a new request.
